## Antec TP-550C Overview

The TruePower Classic TP-550C 550W Power Supply from Antec was built to comply with the toughest energy standard available, ErP Lot 6: 2013. The TP-550C is 80 PLUS GOLD certified and can operate at up to 92% efficiency. High Current Rails and a 98% +12V output ratio maximizes the TP-550C's capabilities to power high-performance processors and graphics cards.

The PhaseWave design is a server-class LLC design with a synchronous rectification based on a DC-DC topology. Japanese capacitors achieve tight voltage regulation for low ripple and noise, which can maximize your system's performance. Antec's intelligent Thermal Manager fan control spins the high-quality 120 mm double-ball-bearing fan to cool your TP-550C quietly and efficiently. CircuitShield makes the TP-550C safe and reliable with its eight industrial-grade protections.

Title: Antec TruePower Classic Series 750 W Review
URL: https://www.techpowerup.com/review/antec-tp-750c/3.html
Published: 2014-02-07T13:40:00.000Z
Author: crmaris , on
Highlights:
The box the TP-750C comes in is small and has a photo of the unit's front at its face. Near the top-right corner are the badges for its five year warranty and Gold-certified efficiency. Antec also highlights the PSU's most notable features at the bottom of the front. 

 This side lists the unit's specifications in four languages we don't speak. 

 A table including the power specifications and a description of all included connectors can be found here. Antec should have also included cable lengths here. 

 Antec says the most crucial features of this unit to be its high efficiency and its compliance with the latest ATX v.2.4 spec, and its five year warranty. 

 The back of the box is covered in paragraphs that describe the unit's specifications in many different languages. Antec also placed a bunch of badges on top of the box. Among the latter is a ErP Lot 6 icon, which means that the TP-750C consumes less than 0.5 W in standby.

Wszystkie kable posiadają pełen oplot. Zarówno model 550, jak i 650 W oferuje takie same wtyczki. Mamy tutaj po jednej 24 pin ATX i 8 pin EPS. Poza tym dwie wtyczki 6+2 pin dla kart graficznych PCI-E oraz jeden kabel z trzema wtyczkami Molex i jedną FDD oraz dwa kable z trzema wtyczkami SATA i jedną Molex.

...

Zacznijmy do modelu TruePower TP-550C, który oferuje klasyczny układ elementów na płytce drukowanej z zespołem dynamicznych transformatorów rezonansowych. Technologia ta opiera się na wysoko wydajnej topologii rezonansowej, którą wykorzystuje się m.in. w monitorach. Poza tym mamy tutaj układy VRM (Voltage Regulator Module) odpowiedzialne za linie +3,3V oraz +5 V. Na samej górze umieszczono cztery radiatory odpowiedzialne za odprowadzanie ciepła z grzejących się układów. Projektantem tej jednostki jest Seasonic, co powinno nas zdecydowanie ucieszyć.

...

Do chłodzenia wykorzystywany jest wentylator ADDA AD1212HB-A70GL, który ma średnicę 120 mm i oferuje przepływ 75 CFM przy szumie 42 dBa. Prędkość maksymalna wynosi 2200 obrotów na minutę. Wiemy jednak, że model ten posiada certyfikat 80Plus GOLD, dlatego zapewne nawet w ekstremalnych warunkach nie będzie korzystał z takiej prędkości.

Wnętrze zasilacza TP-650C również jest projektem Seasonic. Podstawowymi elementami są kondensatory Nippon Chemi-Con (470 uF, 450 V), które mogą pracować w temperaturze105 stopni Celsjusza. Ogólnie rzecz biorąc, układ na płytce wydaje się być bardzo dobrze przemyślany, a jakość lutowania bardzo dobra.

 1 TP-650C POWER SUPPLY USER’S MANUAL 2 TP-650C Antec’s TruePower Classic series sets new standards for power supplies. TruePower Classic is one of the first series to comply with the toughest energy standard available, ErP Lot 6: 2013. By using a PSU that is 80 PLUS® GOLD certified, operating up to 92% efficient, you can reduce your electricity bill by up to 20% when compared to many other power supplies. Backed by a 5 year warranty and lifetime global 24/7 support, the TP-650C is the guaranteed gold standard for power. STANDARDS AND FEATURES The connectors and power specifications of the TP-650C PSU are all compatible with ATX12V v2.4 and EPS12V v2.92 specifications. The TP-650C features Universal Input, which automatically senses when you connect the power supply to any AC power source between 100 - 240V without setting a voltage switch. This power supply also features Active Power Factor Correction (PFC), which improves the power factor value of the power supply by altering the input current wave shape, helping to power transmission across the grid. SYSTEM PROTECTION A variety of industrial-grade safety circuitry will help protect your computer: Over Current Protection (OCP), Over Voltage Protection (OVP), Under Voltage Protection (UVP), Short Circuit Protection (SCP), Over Power Protection (OPP), Over Temparature Protection (OTP), Surge & Inrush Protection (SIP), No Load Operation (NLO) & Brown-Out Protection (BOP). Sometimes the PSU will “latch” into a protected state. You will need to power off the PSU and clear the fault before it will function again. There are no user-replaceable fuses in your TP-650C. 3 80 PLUS® CERTIFICATION 80 PLUS® certification is the most widely recognized independent standard in power supply efficiency. An 80 PLUS® certified power supply uses less energy and generates less heat to stay cooler, run quieter and last longer. The TP-650Chas been 80 PLUS® GOLD certified to be at least 87% efficient at a wide range of operating loads; this will lower your operating costs and help protect the environment.
